embed.title: Help
embed.description: Type `{{prefix}}help <command>` for details on any of the commands below.

fields.name: Tracking commands
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help track` — alerts for specific pokemon (IV, CP, PVP)
`{{prefix}}help raid` — raid bosses at gyms
`{{prefix}}help egg` — raid eggs before they hatch
`{{prefix}}help quest` — field research tasks
`{{prefix}}help incident` — Team Rocket, Kecleon, Showcases, gold stops
`{{prefix}}help lure` — lure modules at pokestops
`{{prefix}}help nest` — pokemon nest spawns
`{{prefix}}help gym` — gym team changes and battles
`{{prefix}}help fort` — pokestop/gym location updates
`{{prefix}}help maxbattle` — dynamax/gigantamax raids
`{{prefix}}help tappable` — reward tappables (candy, items, stardust)

fields.name: Review and remove tracking
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help tracked` — list everything you're tracking
`{{prefix}}help untrack` — remove tracking entries
`{{prefix}}help summary` — buffer alerts and deliver grouped on a schedule
`{{prefix}}help script` — export your tracking as commands

fields.name: Look up
fields.value: `{{prefix}}help info` — pokemon details, moves, items, current weather, shiny rates

fields.name: Your account and alerts
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help poracle` — register (or re-enable) your account
`{{prefix}}help area` — choose which areas to receive alerts for
`{{prefix}}help location` — set your home/current location
`{{prefix}}help profile` — multiple tracking profiles (home/work/weekend)
`{{prefix}}help language` — change bot response language
`{{prefix}}help start` / `{{prefix}}help stop` — pause or resume alerts
`{{prefix}}help mute` — silence alerts for a gym, pokemon, area, or pokestop for a while
`{{prefix}}help unregister` — delete your account and all tracking

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admin commands{{/if}}
fields.value:
{{#if userIsAdmin}}`{{prefix}}help enable` / `{{prefix}}help disable` — manage other users
`{{prefix}}help broadcast` — send a message to everyone
`{{prefix}}help userlist` — list registered users
`{{prefix}}help community` — area-security community membership{{/if}}

fields.name: Filter syntax (applies to most tracking commands)
fields.value: All filters use `key:value` form — e.g. `iv:100`, `cp:2000-3000`, `level:25-35`, `d:500`. Ranges are written `low-high` and are always preferred over separate `miniv`/`maxiv` variants — easier to read and easier to change. Use `everything` as the pokemon name to match all pokemon.
